main_rule: At each completed calendar month end, hold each ETF's fixed allocation if its distribution-reinvested index exceeds the same month-end index 12 months earlier; otherwise retain that allocation as USD cash.
main_risk_rule: At month end compute 126-session covariance of same-pool daily total returns. Scale all base weights by min(1,0.10/sqrt(w'cov*w*252)). Apply trend gates after this scale; no upward rescaling when assets turn off. Rebalance monthly only.
commission: Every order max(1 USD,0.005 USD/share), plus 0.5 bps notional as conservative regulatory/clearing allowance; base adverse slippage 5 bps per side. Minimum commission cap ignored conservatively for tiny orders.
cash_account: No borrowing. Sell reductions at first true exchange open after month-end. Sale proceeds settle T+3 before 2017-09-05, T+2 before 2024-05-28, T+1 afterwards. Buy batch after settlement, with quantities fixed using the preceding session's close and 2% buying-power reserve. Prior-close-based order that cannot be funded at actual adverse open is rejected, not resized with future knowledge.
dividends: Use unadjusted prices and explicit cash-distribution events. Ex-date entitlement goes to shares held over prior close; include receivable in NAV but do not spend until ex-date+60 calendar days, next session. 90-day payment-lag and 30% distribution-withholding stresses. Payment dates are conservative diagnostic assumptions, not verified actual dates. Fund expense ratio embedded in market price; not charged twice.
splits: Fail closed if any split event occurs within the requested surface; selected seven must have none. Never treat adjclose as trade price.
calendar: XNYS regular exchange sessions for shared US calendar; PDBC listed Nasdaq, whose regular trading dates coincide for requested interval but not claiming exchange-specific microstructure. All vendor bars must match grid and be closed at fixed cutoff. Missing/invalid rows fail, no forward/zero fill.
currency: USD starting capital and all instruments trade USD. No account FX conversion assumed; EFA embedded foreign-currency economic exposure retained. Personal tax residency, access, estate/capital-gains taxes and broker entitlements unknown.
acceptance: First require valid ledger and no lookahead. Economic candidate only if base CAGR positive, max drawdown <=30%, 20bps stress positive, and trend supplies either >=10% relative drawdown improvement with no more than 1 percentage-point CAGR sacrifice against static_risk10, OR >=1 percentage-point CAGR increment without >2 percentage-point drawdown deterioration. Neighbors quantify parameter fragility, not choose a winner. No annual win-rate, Sharpe 1, or full-SPY outperformance gate. Raw-unaccepted input or unverified actual execution yields a concrete data/execution blocker despite diagnostic economics.
attribution: Static equal weight vs SPY: diversification/opportunity cost. Static risk10 vs static equal weight: risk scaling. Trend risk10 vs static risk10: trend/conditional exposure, not automatically prediction alpha. Additional ex-post volatility-matched static series is labelled descriptive and nontradable.
concentration: Calendar years, 2016-19/2020-21/2022/2023-24/2025+ blocks, dollar PnL by asset, leave-best-year-out compounding. Do not require each block profitable.
disclosure: Contemporary surviving broad ETFs chosen by tradable economic role, not reconstructed historical ETF universe. No historical selection claim; 12M inspired by prior revealed family evidence. PDBC chosen for no-K1 structure, shortens history and excludes 2008.
future: No trading or scheduler deployment authorized. If economically qualified freeze object and a read-only local monthly decision/log entrypoint. 30-60 days tests operations only; no claim of future validation.
